$comment: Interface texts in English. Same keys and placeholders as ru.json.
language.name: English
home.title: Your preparation plan
home.scope: Deadlines are calculated for two procedures only; migration registration goes through your university. Marks are self-reported, not an official decision.
card.procedureSource: Procedure per the {uni} page: {url} (checked {date}). This is the university's rule, not the bot's calculation.
home.undated: No calculated deadline — the university's own rules; the deadline depends on a date the bot does not know (move-in, end of registration or visa), see the card:
home.reminders.off: Reminders: off. Turn them on — the bot will write 7, 3 and 1 day before each date at 09:00 Moscow time and once the day after it.
card.consequence: If you do not complete it: {text} — {act}, {article} (checked {date}).
card.overdue: The calculated date has passed. You still need to complete the procedure — do not put it off. The bot does not assess what the delay means in your case: ask {uni} what to do — a ready question is behind the button below.
card.docsNoSource: No official list of documents is published: always bring your passport and confirm the rest with {uni}.
calendar.intro: Your dates as a file: open it to add the events to your phone calendar. The calendar will remind you 7, 3 and 1 day before at 09:00 Moscow time, even with bot notifications off. These are calculated dates, not an official decision. After changing your marks, export again: events update instead of duplicating.
help.generic.draft: I study at {uni} and need help with __. My obstacle is __. Please explain the next step and required documents.
help.unsupported: We do not calculate unsupported cases.
help.unsupported.scope: Reason: the scenario conditions did not match (age 18+, first entry for study longer than 90 days, entry from {from}, university dormitory, no residence permit and no previously completed procedures), and the bot has no rules for another case. If you made a mistake, go back to the question.
help.unsupported.citizenship: Reason: the bot's rules have no deadlines for this citizenship. If you made a mistake, go back to the question.
help.unsupported.other: Reason: “Other” is a citizenship outside the list the scenario is checked for at {uni}. Deadlines may apply to you — ask the university. If you made a mistake, go back to the question.
help.unsupported.draft: Hello! I am an international {uni} student. My case does not fit the standard scenario: ___. Could you tell me which procedures and deadlines apply to me after entry and which documents to prepare?
help.draft: Hello! I am an international {uni} student ({who}). I need to complete “{title}”, calculated deadline {due}. The problem: ___. Could you tell me the next step and the documents I need?
help.draft.overdue: Hello! I am an international {uni} student ({who}). I need to complete “{title}”; the calculated deadline was {due} and has passed. The reason: ___. Could you tell me how to complete it now and which documents I need?
help.intro: What is in the way: a missing document, no booking, or an unclear next step? Here is a ready question for {uni}: copy it, replace ___ with your obstacle and send it yourself:
help.intro.overdue: The calculated date has passed. Do not put it off: tell {uni} and ask how to complete the procedure now. The bot does not assess the consequences and is not legal advice. A ready question: copy it, replace ___ with the reason and send it yourself:
consent: The bot stores your MAX ID, language, dates and checkmarks in its database until deletion or 400 days of inactivity. To measure usefulness it only counts daily totals of actions, without your MAX ID. Do not send passports or medical files. /delete removes your profile and queued jobs; event fingerprints expire within 7 days. This is preparation support, not legal advice. Continue?
scope: Scope: age 18+, first entry for study longer than 90 days, {uni} dormitory, no residence permit and no previously completed procedures. Entry from {from}. Does everything match? Not entered yet — answer “Yes” too: a “Not in Russia yet” button comes later. In demo, answer for a fictional student.
university.gone: The university you chose is no longer in the bot's list. Calculations are paused: the bot will not show another university's addresses and contacts instead of yours. After you choose a university, answer the questions again.
university.choose: Choose your university. The deadlines are the same for everyone, but addresses, documents and contacts differ from one university to another.
university.missing: So far the bot only knows the universities on the list: without the university's address, documents and contacts the plan would be incomplete. Ask your university's international office about the deadlines.
entry: Entry date: DD.MM.YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD, from {from} through today.
entry.invalid: The date is before {from}: the bot counts deadlines only for an entry from {from} through today; /help for support.
entry.format: Cannot read the date. Enter DD.MM.YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD, for example 05.09.2026; /help for support.
entry.future: Entry date cannot be in the future: deadlines count from your actual entry. Send the date when you enter.
entry.future.beforeEntry: Not in Russia yet? The button below shows what to prepare in advance.
completion: Enter the actual completion date (DD.MM.YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD) or /today. This is self-reported, not confirmation from the authorities.
completion.invalid: Use a date between entry and today, later than the previous completion. /plan to cancel.
card.uniTarget: {uni} asks for it sooner: by {date}, according to the {uni} page (checked {checked}); the deadline above is the legal one
docEnd.visa-end: Until what date is your visa valid? A date as DD.MM.YYYY, as in the visa. The bot will count the date by the university's rule and remind you 7, 3 and 1 day before.
docEnd.registration-end: Until what date is your registration valid? A date as DD.MM.YYYY, from the tear-off part of the arrival notice. The bot will count the date by the university's rule and remind you 7, 3 and 1 day before.
docEnd.invalid: The date must be today or later and no more than two years ahead. /plan — cancel.
card.endNote: The bot counted this by the {uni} rule from the end date you entered ({end}); it is not a decision of the Interior Ministry. Check the date against the document.
card.endPassed: By the university's rule the submission deadline ({due}) has passed — contact {uni} as soon as possible.
procedure.reminder: Reminder: {title} — submit the documents by {due} ({left}). This is the university's rule, counted from the date you entered.
visit: {title}: which day will you go? A date as DD.MM.YYYY — from today and no more than a year ahead. At 18:00 Moscow time the day before, the bot will tell you which documents from the list are still missing.
visit.invalid: The date must be today or later and no more than a year ahead. /plan — cancel.
visit.late: This is after the calculated deadline ({due}) — try to go earlier.
visit.remindOn: At 18:00 the day before, the bot will remind you which documents are missing.
visit.remindOff: Turn on reminders under the plan, and the bot will remind you the day before which documents are missing.
repeat.label: repeat ({period})
card.repeat: Repeat ({period}). Marked done by you on {date}.
visit.ready: All documents on the list are checked — take the originals.
delete: Delete your profile, checkmarks and all pending messages?
deleted: Your data and pending messages were deleted. /start to begin again.
limited: Too many actions in a row: the last one was not applied. Wait a minute and try again.
stoppedNoPlan: There are no reminders yet: they can be turned on once the plan is ready. Tap “Continue” to return to the current step.
rulesChanged: Rules changed. Calculations are paused. Use /delete and start again.
reminder.overdue: Reminder: {title} — the calculated deadline was {due}. You still need to complete it: the card shows what to do and a ready question for your university.
ics.name: First 90 days
ics.universityNote: Counted by the bot by the university's rule from the document end date you entered; not a decision of the Interior Ministry.
ics.calculated: Calculated date, not an official decision.
ics.provisional: The rule has not been legally reviewed yet.
app.title: First 90 days
app.banner.mocked: Launched without a MAX signature: local debugging, not production.
app.error.launch: This app opens from the bot in MAX. Use the button in the chat.
app.error.expired: The launch data expired. Close the app and open it from the chat again.
app.error.offline: No connection to the server. Check the network and try again.
app.error.server: The server could not process the action. Nothing was changed.
app.error.conflict: The data changed in another window — the screen has been refreshed.
app.error.download: Could not save the calendar file. Please try again.
app.error.busy: Too many actions in a row. Wait a minute and try again: nothing was changed.
app.start.title: Your mandatory procedures
app.start.body: We calculate your deadlines after entry and list the documents to collect.
app.provisional: The rule has not been reviewed by a lawyer yet — the date is provisional.
app.selfReported: Marks are self-reported, not an official decision.
app.entry.body: Entry date as DD.MM.YYYY, from {from} through today.
app.entry.invalid: Date is outside the scenario. Enter a date from {from} through today.
app.entry.future: Entry date cannot be in the future: deadlines count from your actual entry.
app.entry.nodate: This date does not exist in the calendar. Check the day and the month.
app.completion.body: Completion date as DD.MM.YYYY. This is self-reported, not confirmation from the authorities.
app.completion.invalid: Use a date between entry and today, later than the previous completion.
app.visit.invalid: The date must be today or later and no more than a year ahead.
app.docEnd.invalid: The date must be today or later and no more than two years ahead.
app.calendar: Add the dates to my calendar
share.provisional: The deadlines are counted from the entry date and are preliminary: the rules have not yet been reviewed by a lawyer. Please check with {uni}.
app.scopeTitle: Let us check the scenario fits
app.done.title: All marked
app.done.body: Your after-entry procedures are marked, as reported by you. Keep the papers you were given.
app.consent: The bot stores your MAX ID, language, dates and checkmarks in its database until deletion or 400 days of inactivity. To measure usefulness it only counts daily totals of actions, without your MAX ID. Do not send passports or medical files. The “Delete my data” button at the bottom of the plan removes your profile and queued jobs; event fingerprints expire within 7 days. This is preparation support, not legal advice. Continue?
app.deleted: Your data and pending messages were deleted. Tap “Start” to begin again.
app.rulesChanged: Rules changed. Calculations are paused. Delete the old profile with the “Delete my data” button and start again.
app.question: Question to the university
app.copyManual: Could not copy — select the text above and copy it by hand.
poster.title: Your first 90 days in Russia
poster.lead: Get your deadlines for the medical examination and fingerprinting, with reminders
poster.scan: Point your phone camera at the code to open the bot in MAX
poster.note: The bot calculates deadlines from your entry date, reminds you and drafts a question to {uni}. It does not file documents and is not legal advice.
btn.beforeEntry: Not in Russia yet — what to prepare
beforeEntry.title: What to prepare at home before entry — for a {uni} student. No deadline is counted here: the entry date is not known yet.
beforeEntry.scope: This is not a full list: it shows only what the university writes on its own pages. Check the general rules of entry to Russia for your country (a visa or the Gosuslugi RuID app) with the Russian consulate or the university's international office.
beforeEntry.next: Once you have entered, send your entry date — the bot will build your deadline plan.
